# Code of Conduct

Contributors are expected to participate respectfully, constructively, and in good faith. Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, doxxing, deliberate misinformation, credential sharing, and attempts to bypass the project’s public/private data boundary are not acceptable.

Maintainers may remove, reject, or revert contributions that violate this standard or introduce unsupported policy claims, fabricated sources, unsafe automation, or confidential material. Report conduct concerns privately to the repository owner through GitHub rather than publishing sensitive evidence in an issue or pull request.

This policy applies to repository discussions, issues, pull requests, and all project-related communication.
